title: 'We are watching you' postcard
summary: Bryce Zable tells of 'We are watching you' postcard, about c. 1995 at Bryce Zable's home address, Los Angeles, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Bryce Zable's home address, Los Angeles

tellings.quote: A year before when we're shooting the pilot, um I get a postcard to my home address and it's got a picture on the front cover.

plain: A Los Angeles television writer, Bryce Zable, says that around 1995, a year before his UFO-themed TV show went ahead, while he was shooting its first episode, a postcard arrived at his home address. He says the front showed the cover of a book called Flying Eyes, with the words WE ARE WATCHING YOU. He tells it as a hint that someone was keeping an eye on people making UFO stories in Hollywood.
